notes: Short-form copy deck for the scroll-driven homepage. One headline, one line, one telemetry strip per chapter. English is a label, not a second narrative. Voice rule (2026-10-29): names may be metaphors (纸版 / 伴读层 / 试读层 / 认领), verbs may not personify — no 醒 / 睡 / 等 / 跟着 / 长出 / 应答 / 忘 / 打扰. The companion layer is glossed in plain words at 00, the first place it appears. 2026-10-29: 云魂 renamed to 伴读层; 两个身体 replaced by 两版 (paper edition + companion layer).

chapters.label: PROLOGUE
chapters.heroLine: 不装电池。不用开机。翻到哪页，读哪页。

chapters.label: SHELF
chapters.line: 任何一本书，第一次翻开时，都是新的。
chapters.lineEn: Every book is new the first time it is opened.
chapters.note: 纸版是这本书本身；伴读层是它的云端部分——讲题、音频、图谱、问答。

chapters.label: CARRY
chapters.note: 收银台不绑定任何东西。认领发生在家里，在纸页上。

chapters.label: INTERACTION
chapters.line: 书签落下，纸就有了地址。
chapters.lineEn: The ribbon lands. The page has an address.

chapters.label: BINDING
chapters.line: 页边之外，另有一张图谱。
chapters.lineEn: One scan. Nine nodes on one page.

chapters.label: LOOP
chapters.line: 讲题、图谱、问答，都在页边。
chapters.lineEn: Video, graph, answers — all in the margin.

chapters.label: READ
chapters.line: 电子档在手里。往下滑，页跟着走。
chapters.lineEn: The e-book in hand. Scroll, and the pages follow.

chapters.label: RETURN
chapters.line: 书不记名。下一位，重新开始。
chapters.lineEn: No reader data. Next reader starts clean.

chapters.label: CHAIN
chapters.line: 教育图书出版行业的全产业链技术服务商。
chapters.lineEn: A full-stack technology partner for education publishing.
